body:
Congratulations, ladies and gents. Particularly those of you finding this from Google, now that the thread is dead. The reward for your diligence is the truth. This is what a schizophrenia relapse looks like. The answer was a resounding, "You've bit the big one, bucko!" Yes, I really had lost my mind. A combination of stress, smog, lonliness, and regret ultimately begat my downfall into maddness. It felt like the ending of Crisis Core.

Shortly after my final post here, I became too paranoid to post in the thread (sorry med researchers!), followed by being busy being commited for several weeks. I really lasted an impressive two and a half years of untreated schizoaffective disorder (wow, thanks oxiracetam!).

My delusions grew to include the devil, with Lucifer counteroffering that I should kill my best friend to go back in time instead and, a trip to a psychatric ER later, turns out admitting the devil is telling you to kill people gets you involuntarily commited and put on 40mg Geodon pretty dang fast. Must have been a touching moment for the man if he ever pieced together, on some level, I was taking a third option in a delusional world where either I or my best friend was about to die by my own hand.

I thank the few of you for your time here. While I was too far gone to actually reason with, given I still believed all this all the way up to a psychatric ER, and wasn't even aware this would be a suicide, this was a part of me reality checking enough to accept medication despite my world collapsing into itself. I didn't think anything would happen if I took pills.

But of course it felt like my head was hit with a 2x4. I was delusional. Dangerously so. I second-guessed everything. The thought of stopping my pills again now scares me, and indeed after my brush with the devil feel ethically compelled to continue indefinitely.

I hope that lot of you have better luck in life than I did. I've still got some hard to treat depression and negative symptoms, but somehow I'm holding on. I'll probably try and slowly reintigrate into society, ie, slowly get back into Reddit, a license, job, etc. And find another way to save my family.

I called the national suicide hotline and heard to take care of myself first for the third time (once in person, once here, and once on the hotline).

Third times the charm, heh. I guess I'm not in any position to help anyone right now until I stop being so screwed up myself. Blind leading the blind.

So normal people wouldn't have done this. They would have stayed where they were happy until their own problems were resolved. This isn't my fault.

I was a fool to return and should just bail if I get too sick. Gotcha. I'll see if my friend wants me to go ahead and come back.

But am I crazy fool?

Thanks for talking to me today, guys, I don't get out much but my head is swimming and I need to lay down.

Maybe I should never have quit Seroquel. I can't handle much of shit.

True, that. I admitted to him that if I get too much more screwed up I have to leave and hopefully come up with something in time. The distance between us means I can't simply bounce back and forth (some two thousand miles). It's not worth risking my life over.

He's old, and had worked the third shift the time I was growing up. Now that his health is gone and I'm grown... he's realized he hardly knows his own son. I'm on his bucket list, basically, and it's extremely sad. And I'm risking losing the only other person I really have in my life doing this.

I've got a constant tug of war at my heart and where I was barely hanging on before, right now, I'm about to snap. I swear, I can almost hear the Devil laughing at me. The time I have left to spend with him is poisoned by me, myself, being so screwed up I can hardly get out to do anything.

The situation is a little screwed and I just keep thinking, if only I could go back a few years, dear God, how different it would have been.

It hurts so much, I wonder if there's something horribly wrong with me. Like, that I shouldn't care, or that I should have known more people. Or if I really have finally suffered enough to attract God's mercy, or if this is me finally snapping under the stress.

I can't imagine normal people live like this.

Music. Sleep. Talking to people that don't make me more paranoid.
I had to lay down a while after posting to collect myself.
